definitions.explanation: Alcoholic drinks of Western origin, such as whisky, wine, and brandy, as distinguished from sake and other traditional Japanese drinks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{洋酒|ようしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧{洋酒|ようしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そろえて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: That shop stocks rare Western liquors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{贈|おく}り{物|もの}→贈り物：01343_okurimono⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{銘柄|めいがら}→銘柄：14500_meigara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{洋酒|ようしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: As a gift, I picked out a bottle of a famous brand of Western liquor.

notes:
A collective term for Western-style alcoholic drinks — whisky, wine, brandy, liqueurs, and so on — contrasted with ⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧ and other traditional Japanese drinks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洋酒|ようしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to drink Western liquor
- {洋酒|ようしゅ}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧: the liquor section (of a store)
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧{洋酒|ようしゅ}: premium imported spirits

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {和酒|わしゅ}: Japanese alcoholic drinks — the contrasting category
- ⟦{地酒|じざけ}→地酒：18761_jizake⟧: local sake — sake brewed by a regional brewery
